Santiago Vega  
santiago.vega@email.com | (555) 123-4567 | San Francisco, CA | linkedin.com/in/santiagovega | github.com/santivaga  

A QA/Test Engineer at SolutionsPro, where I’ve contributed to refining test frameworks and optimizing automation pipelines across high-stakes projects. With a focus on scalable solutions and measurable outcomes, my work has streamlined testing processes, reduced manual effort, and enhanced product reliability. My expertise spans test automation, API validation, and integrating development practices into quality assurance workflows.  

At SolutionsPro, I spearheaded the implementation of a test automation framework using Playwright, reducing regression test cycles by 40% while improving coverage for critical user journeys. I also collaborated with DevOps teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated tests ran seamlessly alongside code deployments. At InnovateTech, I developed a Python-based tool to parse and validate REST API responses, identifying inconsistencies in third-party integrations that impacted data integrity. This work directly supported a healthcare platform’s compliance with HIPAA standards. My ability to align testing strategies with business goals has positioned me as a key contributor to delivery timelines and quality assurance.  

At DevWorks Consulting, I transitioned from manual testing to a structured BDD/TDD approach, which improved test coverage by 25% and reduced defect resolution time. I also led the automation of API testing for a fintech application, using Postman and Python scripts to validate endpoints under high concurrency, ensuring stability during peak usage. At TechNova Solutions, my intern role involved documenting test procedures and identifying gaps in existing test cases, which later informed the development of a centralized test repository. These experiences solidified my ability to balance technical rigor with cross-functional collaboration.  

University of Technology | Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | 2023  

Technical Skills:  
- **Test Automation**: Developed and maintained automation suites using Selenium/Playwright, achieving 85% coverage for core application workflows.  
- **API Testing**: Designed and executed test cases for REST APIs, ensuring compliance with contractual SLAs and reducing integration bottlenecks.  
- **BDD/TDD**: Implemented behavior-driven development practices, aligning test scenarios with business requirements and improving team alignment.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Integrated test automation into deployment pipelines, enabling continuous validation and reducing environment setup time.  
- **Python**: Leveraged Python for scripting custom test utilities and data validation scripts, enhancing efficiency in repetitive tasks.  
- **REST API Design**: Collaborated on API specification reviews, ensuring robustness and scalability for microservices architectures.  

Projects:  
- **Healthcare Platform Compliance Audit**: Automated API validation for a HIPAA-compliant platform, identifying 12 critical data leakage risks through Python-based test scripts.  
- **Fintech Application Stress Testing**: Built a load-testing framework using Playwright and Locust, simulating 10,000 concurrent users to validate system resilience.  
- **Centralized Test Repository**: Migrated test cases from disparate systems into a unified platform, improving traceability and reducing onboarding time for new team members.  

Languages: English (fluent), Spanish (proficient)
